fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled truck route into the yard: the wide divided entrance drive off E L Ave leads ~250 ft north to a guard booth in the median where the perimeter road pinches into the trailer/dock yard. Confirmed via z18-z20 satellite + Street View of the entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small standalone ~25-30 ft white gatehouse with paved pad/sidewalk and apron connecting to the perimeter road, sitting in the grass median at the SE entry to the trailer-yard perimeter road (42.2752,-85.3789). Clear single-structure booth, not the main building.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a physical guard booth is present.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: False: very deep landscaped entrance apron off a low-traffic rural road provides ample stacking before the gate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide divided concrete entrance apron with unused paved width and a long approach; room to add an express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock-door bank with 40-50 trailers backed in along the north face plus a ~20-door east-face bank; total well into 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large L-shaped trailer parking field on the NW/N holding 60+ trailers without tractors = 50+ band; dedicated drop yard present.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock banks on different building faces (north and east) suggest separated ship/receive, though door function not directly confirmable from imagery.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated from perimeter polygon (~92 acres of fenced/maintained property).
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main DC plus a separate office/support building ~600m SE on the same parcel frontage; campus character is minor so multipleFacilities left false.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; nearest rail is the I-94 corridor, not a siding.
